headline: Congress summons Nvidia's Huang as reports link him to alleged Chinese spy
summary: Congress summoned Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang over reports that China's intelligence service recruited a Megaspeed executive to spy on him, with US officials describing a romantic relationship some called a honeypot operation. Outlets differ on whether the recruitment claim stems from a New York Times report or a separately circulated US intelligence memo.
